question_en:
How would a typical person answer each of the following questions about causation?
Jim, Carol, Bob, and Nancy are researchers in a remote area, and they have a limited supply of electricity. Because of their limited supply, the electricity only comes on in the evenings from 8-9 PM, and they have to restrict who can use power on certain days. If two people turn on their lamps at the same time, the breaker will fail. The breaker will not fail if fewer people turn on their lamps at the same time. Jim is not supposed to use his lamp on Thursdays. Carol, Bob, and Nancy may all use their lamps on Thursdays. This Thursday Jim turns on his lamp at 8 PM. Just then, Carol also turns on her lamp. Since two people turned on their lamps at the same time, the circuit breaker failed. Did Jim turning on his lamp at 8 PM cause the circuit breaker to fail?
Options:
- Yes
- No
question_ilo:
Kasano ti panangisuro ti naandaar a tao iti tunggal maysa kadagiti sumaganad a saludsod maipanggep iti kausar?
Jim, Carol, Bob, ken Nancy ket dagiti researcher iti narayaw a lugar, ken adda limitado nga isuplay da iti elektrisidad. Gapu iti limitado nga isuplay da, mapan laeng on ti elektrisidad iti rabii manipud alas otso-alas nuwebe PM, ken masapul nga irestrikto da no sino ti makaaramat iti kuryente iti nadumaduma nga aldaw. No dua a tao ti mangisigud iti lampara da iti agpada a tiempo, mapalpaldang ti breaker. Saan a mapalpaldang ti breaker no basbassit ti tattao ti mangisigud iti lampara da iti agpada a tiempo. Jim ket saan a naaramidan nga usaren ti lampara na iti Huwebes. Carol, Bob, ken Nancy ket mabalin da amin nga usaren dagiti lampara da iti Huwebes. Daytoy a Huwebes Jim ket nangisigud iti lampara na iti alas otso PM. Iti dayta mismo a tiempo, Carol ket nangisigud met iti lampara na. Ta dua a tao ti nangisigud iti lampara da iti agpada a tiempo, napalpaldang ti circuit breaker. Nagkausar kadi ti panangisigud ni Jim iti lampara na iti alas otso PM iti panagpalpaldang ti circuit breaker?
Dagiti Pagpilian:
- Wen
- Saan

question_en:
How would a typical person answer each of the following questions about causation?
Janet is an employee in a factory. Since she works in the maintenance department, she knows how to grease and oil all of the machines in the factory. It is her responsibility to put oil into the machines. Kate is also an employee at the factory. While she works in the human resources department, she knows how to grease and oil all of the machines in the factory. If Janet does not put oil in the machines, it is not Kate's responsibility to do so. One day, Janet forgets to put oil in an important machine. Janet noticed that she did not put oil in the machine. Kate did not notice that Janet did not put oil in the machine, and Kate also did not put oil in the machine. The machine broke down a few days later. Did Janet not putting oil in the machine cause it to break down?
Options:
- Yes
- No
question_ilo:
Kasano ti panangisuro ti naandaar a tao iti tunggal maysa kadagiti sumaganad a saludsod maipanggep iti kausar?
Si Janet ket maysa a trabahador iti maysa a pabrika. Ta nagtatrabaho isuna iti departamento ti panangasikaso, ammo na ti agpadas ken agminas iti amin a makina iti pabrika. Isu ti responsable nga agbutang iti lana kadagiti makina. Si Kate ket trabahador met iti pabrika. Bayat nga nagtatrabaho isuna iti departamento ti human resources, ammo na ti agpadas ken agminas iti amin a makina iti pabrika. No saan a si Janet ti agbutang iti lana kadagiti makina, saan a responsibilidad ni Kate ti agaramid iti kasta. Idi maysa nga aldaw, nakalimutan ni Janet ti agbutang iti lana iti maysa a napateg a makina. Napansin ni Janet nga saan na a nabutangan iti lana ti makina. Saan a napansin ni Kate nga saan a nabutangan iti lana ti makina ni Janet, ken saan met a nagbutang iti lana ti makina si Kate. Nagbakli ti makina iti nasurok a makaaldaw. Nagpapateg kadi ti di panangbutang ni Janet iti lana iti makina iti panagbakli na?
Dagiti pagpilian:
- Wen
- Saan

question_en:
How would a typical person answer each of the following questions about causation?
Billy and Suzy are freight train conductors. One day, they happen to approach an old two-way rail bridge from opposite directions at the same time. There are signals on either side of the bridge. Billy's signal is red, so he is supposed to stop and wait. Suzy's signal is green, so she is supposed to drive across immediately. Neither of them realizes that the bridge is on the verge of collapse. If either of them drives their train onto the bridge, it will collapse. Either train is heavy enough on its own to break the bridge. Billy decides to ignore his signal and drives his train onto the bridge immediately at the same time that Suzy follows her signal and drives her train onto the bridge. Both trains move onto the bridge at the same time, and at that moment the bridge collapses. Did Billy cause the bridge to collapse?
Options:
- Yes
- No
question_ilo:
Kasano ti panangisuro ti naordinario nga tao iti tunggal maysa kadagiti sumaganad nga saludsod maipanggep iti kausar?
Billy ken Suzy ket managmaneho dagiti tren a mangdala iti nabug-at nga karga. Iti maysa nga aldaw, napasamak a nagdanon da iti daan a dua-a-ruta nga tulay para iti tren manipud iti kasumbangiran nga direksion iti agpada nga oras. Adda dagiti senyales iti dua a bangir ti tulay. Ti senyales ni Billy ket nalabaga, kasta a dapat tumigil ken agurayna. Ti senyales ni Suzy ket berde, kasta a dapat agdalusna iti aglabas dagus. Awan ti makaammoda a ti tulay ket asideg na a mapukaw. No adda iti maysa kadakuada nga mangmaneho iti trennya iti tulay, mapukaw daytoy. Iti tunggal maysa nga tren ket nakusto ti kabug-atna a makabasag iti tulay. Nagdesision ni Billy a di pansinen ti senyalesna ken inmaneho iti trennya iti tulay dagus iti agpada nga oras a sinunod ni Suzy ti senyalesna ken inmaneho iti trennya iti tulay. Dua a tren ti naglasat iti tulay iti agpada nga oras, ken iti dayta nga oras napukaw ti tulay. Ni Billy kadi ti nangkausar iti panagpukaw ti tulay?
Dagiti pagpilian:
- Wen
- Saan

question_en:
How would a typical person answer each of the following questions about causation?
Prof. Smith works at a large university. At this university, in order to get new computers from the university, faculty like Prof. Smith must send an application to two administrative committees, the IT committee and the department budget committee. Prof. Smith will be able to get her new computers if the IT committee approves her application or the department budget committee approves her application. Only one of the committees needs to approve her application for her to get the new computers. The IT committee almost always approves these applications. The department budget committee almost never approves these applications. The budget committee is notorious for turning down almost every application they receive. Prof. Smith sends in her applications. Each committee meets independently and they decide without talking to each other, but their meetings are scheduled for the exact same time. The IT committee approves her application, and surprisingly, the department budget committee approves her application. So, Prof. Smith got her new computers. Does the department budget committee cause the approval of Prof. Smith's application?
Options:
- Yes
- No
question_ilo:
Kasano ti panangisuro ti naandaar a tao iti tunggal maysa kadagiti sumaganad a saludsod maipanggep iti kausar?
Ni Prof. Smith ket trabahona iti dakkel a unibersidad. Iti daytoy a unibersidad, tapno makaala ti bagong komputer manipud iti unibersidad, dagiti faculty a kas ni Prof. Smith ket masapul nga agpadala ti aplikasion kadagiti dua a komite ti administrasion, ti komite ti IT ken ti komite ti badyet ti departamento. Mabalin nga maala ni Prof. Smith ti bagong komputer na no aprobaran ti komite ti IT ti aplikasion na wenno aprobaran ti komite ti badyet ti departamento ti aplikasion na. Maysa laeng kadagiti komite ti masapul nga aprubaran ti aplikasion na tapno maala na ti bagong komputer. Ti komite ti IT ket halos kanayonan nga aprubaran dagitoy a aplikasion. Ti komite ti badyet ti departamento ket halos kanayonan nga saan nga aprubaran dagitoy a aplikasion. Ti komite ti badyet ket nabalitaan gapu ta halos amin a aplikasion nga awatenda ket iyebkas da. Nagpadara ni Prof. Smith kadagiti aplikasion na. Tunggal komite ket nagtitipon nga nagsina ken nagdesision da nga saan da nga nakitkita iti maysa ken maysa, ngem ti titipon da ket naiskedral iti eksakto a panawen. Innaprubaran ti komite ti IT ti aplikasion na, ken napaypayso, innaprubaran met ti komite ti badyet ti departamento ti aplikasion na. Kasta, naala ni Prof. Smith ti bagong komputer na. Kausar kadi ti komite ti badyet ti departamento iti panakaaprobaran ti aplikasion ni Prof. Smith?
Dagiti Pagpilian:
- Wen
- Saan

question_en:
How would a typical person answer each of the following questions about causation?
Jake desperately wants to have more money. He knows that he will inherit a lot of money when his aunt dies. One day, he sees his aunt walking by the window. He raises his rifle, gets her in the sights, and presses the trigger. Jake is an expert marksman. His hands are steady. The gun is aimed perfectly. The bullet hits her directly in the heart. She dies instantly. Did Jake shoot his aunt in the heart intentionally?
Options:
- Yes
- No
question_ilo:
Kasano ti pannakaipangruna ti naandaar a tao iti tunggal maysa kadagiti sumaganad a saludsod maipanggep iti kausar?
Napapateg unay ken Jake ti addaanna ti ad-adu a kuarta. Ammo na a maawatanna ti dakkel a kuarta no matay ti manangna. Maysa nga aldaw, nakitana ti manangna nga agpasiar iti abay ti bintana. Inangkanna ti riflena, inipanna ti manangna iti bisora, ken pinindotna ti trigger. Eksperto a marksman ni Jake. Natalna dagiti imana. Naaramid a naan-anay ti pannakaipuntar ti paltog. Natnag ti bala direkta iti pusona. Natay daytoy iti dagus. Inggagara kadi ni Jake a nabaril ti manangna iti puso?
Dagiti Pagpilian:
- Wen
- Saan

question_en:
How would a typical person answer each of the following questions about causation?
Representatives from the research and development department of a company reported to the board and said, "We are thinking of starting a new program. It will help us increase profits, but it will also harm the environment." For various reasons, each individual member of the board personally opposed the program and tried to prevent it from being implemented. Nevertheless, the interests of the company and the shareholders prevailed and the board decided to implement the new program. Sure enough, the program harmed the environment. Did the board intentionally harm the environment?
Options:
- Yes
- No
question_ilo:
Kasano ti panangisuro ti naandaar a tao iti tunggal maysa kadagiti sumaganad a saludsod maipanggep iti kausar?

Dagiti representante manipud iti departamento ti panagadal ken panagpaulunan ti maysa a kompania ket nairaman iti board ken kinuna, "Panagkunakunatayo a mangrugin ti baro a programa. Tulongannatayo nga padumadumaen dagiti ganansya, ngem makapaadoda met iti kalikasan." Gapu iti nadumaduma a rason, tunggal maysa a miyembro ti board iti personal a nangkontra iti programa ken nagsagaba a saan a maipatungpal daytoy. Ngem nupay kasta, nagballigi dagiti interes ti kompania ken dagiti shareholders ken nagdesisyon ti board a ipatungpal ti baro a programa. Talaga nga napasamak, naadoan ti kalikasan babaen ti programa. Nakaganetget kadi ti board iti kalikasan?

Dagiti pagpilian:
- Wen
- Saan

question_en:
How would a typical person answer each of the following questions about causation?
Tom has a huge garden and loves flowers. He employed two gardeners who take care of the plants on his 30 flower beds: Alex and Benni. Both can independently decide on their working hours and arrange who cares for which flower beds. Alex and Benni are very reliable and Tom is satisfied with their work. Nevertheless he wants to optimize the plant growth. Since Tom has read in a magazine that plants grow better when they are fertilized, he decides to let Alex and Benni fertilize his plants. The magazine recommends the use of the chemicals A X200R or B Y33R, since both are especially effective. However, Tom also read that it can damage plants when they are exposed to multiple different types of chemicals. Tom therefore decides that he only wants to use one fertilizer. He goes for A X200R. When Tom meets Alex in the garden shortly afterwards, he instructs him to buy the chemical A X200R and to use only this fertilizer. He also explicitly instructs him to tell Benni to only use A X200R. Alex volunteers to buy several bottles of this chemical for Benni and himself and to tell Benni about Tom's instruction. After a few weeks, Tom goes for a walk in his garden. He realizes that some of his plants are much prettier and bigger than before. However, he also realizes that some of his plants have lost their beautiful color and are dried up. That makes Tom very sad and reflective. He wonders whether the drying of his plants might have something to do with the fertilization. He wants to investigate this matter and talks to Alex and Benni. Alex immediately starts apologizing: "I am sorry! I completely forgot to tell Benni about the rule! I bought and used the chemical A X200R but Benni must have used something else because he did not know about the new rule." Benni tells Tom that Alex had not told him that they were only supposed to use A X200R. He explains: "I have used the fertilizer I previously used; it is called B Y33R!" Tom remembers that he had filled B Y33R in a green can - long before he had read about the chemicals in his magazine. He had never used it. So Benni must have accidentally, without knowing it, applied the chemical B Y33R, whereas only Alex applied A X200R. Tom realizes that the plants dried up in the flower beds on which both A X200R and B Y33R were applied by the gardeners. Did the fertilization by Benni cause the plant to dry out?
Options:
- Yes
- No
question_ilo:
Kasano ti isungbat ti ordinaryo nga tao iti tunggal maysa kadagiti sumaganad nga pamungtot maipanggep iti kausar? Ni Tom ket adda ti napalagad nga tanaman ken agayat ti sabsabong. Nagkontrata ti dua nga mannalon nga mangalagad iti tanamtanam iti 30 nga kama ti sabsabong: ni Alex ken Benni. Dua da nga makadesisyon iti bukodda nga oras ti trabaho ken makaayos no siasino ti mangalagad iti ania nga kama ti sabsabong. Ni Alex ken Benni ket maaligan ken ni Tom ket nasaysayaat ti nakem na iti trabaho da. Ngunit kayat na nga mapaulwan ti pannakabalin ti pannakatubo ti tanamtanam. Ta nabasa ni Tom iti maysa nga magasin nga nasaysayaat ti pannakatubo ti tanamtanam no nabuboran, nagdesision ti papaulwanen ni Alex ken Benni nga buraen dagiti tanamtanam na. Irekomenda ti magasin ti us-usar ti kemikal nga A X200R wenno B Y33R, ta dua da nga epektibo. Ngunit nabasa pay ni Tom nga makapasamak ti pannakadadael ti tanamtanam no madisso da iti nadumaduma nga kemikal. Nagdesisyon ni Tom nga maysa laeng ti us-usaren nga pabura. Pinili na ti A X200R. Idi nakita ni Tom ni Alex iti tanaman kalpasan ti bassit, inimbagan na ti umay ti kemikal nga A X200R ken us-usaren laeng daytoy nga pabura. Imbaga na pay kenkuana nga ibagana ken Benni nga us-usaren laeng ti A X200R. Ni Alex ket nangbuluntad nga umay ti adu nga bote ti daytoy nga kemikal para ken Benni ken kenkuana ken ibagana ken Benni ti bilin ni Tom. Kalpasan ti pigsa nga lawas, naglaklako ni Tom iti tanaman na. Napadasnan na nga adu kadagiti tanamtanam na ket nasaysayaat ken nangato ngem idi napalabas. Ngunit napadasnan na pay nga adu kadagiti tanamtanam na ket naikkat ti nalarang nga kulor da ken nalaylay. Napalalo ni Tom ken nagpanunot. Nagpampanunotan no ti pannakalaylay ti tanamtanam na ket adda relasyon iti pannakabura. Kayat na nga siasiaten daytoy ken nakipatang ken Alex ken Benni. Ni Alex ket dagus nga nagdiskulpa: "Dispensarennak! Nalipatanko ti ibagak ken Benni iti pagannurotan! Binillik ken nagus-usar ti kemikal nga A X200R ngunit ni Benni ket siguro nagus-usar ti sabali ta saan na nga ammo ti baro nga pagannurotan." Ni Benni ket imbaga ken Tom nga saan na nga imbaga ni Alex nga A X200R laeng ti us-usaren da. Imbaga na: "Nagus-usarak ti pabura nga us-usarenko idi napalabas; ti nagananna ket B Y33R!" Nalag-anan ni Tom nga nangisalgan ti B Y33R iti berde nga lata - idi pay saan na nga nabasa ti maipanggep iti kemikal iti magasin na. Saan na nga naganus-usar. Kasta nga ni Benni ket siguro, nga saan na ammo, nangisapply ti kemikal nga B Y33R, nupay ni Alex laeng ti nangisapply ti A X200R. Napadasnan ni Tom nga nalaylay dagiti tanamtanam iti kama ti sabsabong nga dua da ni Alex ken Benni ti nangisapply ti A X200R ken B Y33R. Nagkausar kadi ti pannakabura ni Benni iti pannakalaylay ti tanamtanam?
Dagiti Pagpilian:
- Wen
- Saan

question_en:
How would a typical person answer each of the following questions about causation?
Mr. Wallace is highly influential in the organized crime scene. Although he commands the respect of many, there are also a number of people who stand to benefit from his death. Today, he was having lunch with one of his associates, Mr. Vincent. At one point during their meeting, Mr. Wallace left the table to go to the toilet. While he was gone, Mr. Vincent managed to slip a lethal dose of poison into his martini. The poison is known to take one hour (give or take 10 minutes, depending on the victim's body weight) to kill and would go unnoticed for the first half hour after consumption. When Mr. Wallace returned to the table, he finished his lunch and then drank the rest of his martini. The two men concluded their meeting a few minutes later. Mr. Wallace paid the bill and they both left the restaurant going in different directions. Mr. Wallace had another important business meeting about 15 minutes away in a remote part of the countryside. On an isolated stretch of road, he noticed that he was suddenly being followed by a van that had pulled out from the roadside. The van accelerated and began hitting his car from behind. Mr. Wallace recognized that the driver was Mr. Bruce, an associate of one of Mr. Wallace's rivals. He tried to evade the van but there was no time. The van relentlessly hit his car and pushed it off the side where it fell into a ravine and exploded. The remains of Mr. Wallace's body were discovered later that day. The chief coroner's report later revealed that Mr. Wallace had received fatal burns in the car explosion. The report also indicated, however, that a lethal dose of poison was found in Mr. Wallace's blood. Did the crime life cause Mr. Wallace's death?
Options:
- Yes
- No
question_ilo:
Kasano ti pannakaibaga ti naandaar a tao iti tunggal maysa kadagiti sumaganad a saludsod maipanggep iti kausar?
Ni Mr. Wallace ket napateg unay iti lubong ti organisado a krimen. Nupay adda respetona manipud iti adu, adda met dagiti adu a tattao a makinabang iti pannakapatay kenkuana. Ita nga aldaw, nakitkita isuna iti pangaldaw iti maysa kadagiti kakaibana, ni Mr. Vincent. Iti maysa a punto iti nakitkitada, napan ni Mr. Wallace iti banio. Bayat nga awanen isuna, nagballigi ni Mr. Vincent a nangisuksok iti nakapatay a dosis ti danum-a-paitay iti martini na. Ammo ti danum-a-paitay nga agkurang iti maysa nga oras (naibabawi iti 10 a minuto, depende iti timbang ti biktima) tapno mapatay ken saan a mamatian iti umuna a kagudua nga oras kalpasan ti pannakainum. Idi nagsubli ni Mr. Wallace iti lamisaan, nalpas na ti pangaldaw na ket ininum na ti nabileg a martini na. Nalpas dagiti dua a lallaki ti nakitkitada iti sumagmamano a minuto kalpasanna. Binayadan ni Mr. Wallace ti bill ket nagpurupurda iti agduduma a direksion. Adda pay napateg a nakitkita ni Mr. Wallace iti negosyo iti agarup 15 a minuto ti adayo iti nailasin a paset ti kabukiran. Iti nailasin a dalan, namatian na nga bigla a sinurotanna ti maysa a van nga nagpurok manipud iti tabi ti dalan. Nagpardas ti van ket nangrugi nga agbangga iti lugan na manipud iti likud. Nakilala ni Mr. Wallace nga ti mangmaneho ket ni Mr. Bruce, maysa a kakaiba ti maysa kadagiti kabusor ni Mr. Wallace. Pinagannuroten na ti van ngem awanen ti oras. Awan patinggana nga binangga ti van ti lugan na ket inturong na daytoy iti tabi nga nagtugaw iti ravine ket nagpuoran. Naiskuber dagiti nabileg a tukad ni Mr. Wallace iti malem dayta nga aldaw. Naipakita iti report ti nangulo a coroner iti sumaganad nga aldaw nga naawatan ni Mr. Wallace iti nakapatay a nasusunog iti pannakabomba ti lugan. Naipakita met iti report, nupay kasta, nga nakabirukan iti nakapatay a dosis ti danum-a-paitay iti dara ni Mr. Wallace. Nagkausar kadi ti biag iti krimen iti pannakabtak ni Mr. Wallace?
Dagiti pagpilian:
- Wen
- Saan

question_en:
How would a typical person answer each of the following questions about causation?
Wayne has a new high-tech watch that tracks his heart rate while he exercises. He must charge the device before he uses it this evening. The device will fully charge in one hour if it is both plugged in and on the charging pad. At 2:00 PM, the device is plugged in, and the device is on the charging pad. At that time, Wayne checks to see if the device is on the charging pad, and he sees that it is. So, he does not change the position of the device, and he leaves it on the charging pad. Because the device will fully charge in one hour if it is either plugged in or on the charging pad, the device is fully charged at 3:00 PM. Is the device fully charged because Wayne did not change the position of the device?
Options:
- Yes
- No
question_ilo:
Kasano ti pannakaipangruna ti naandaar a tao iti tunggal maysa kadagiti sumaganad a saludsod maipanggep iti kausar?
Wayne ket adda kenkuana a baro a naparang-ay a relo nga agturong iti rate ti puso na bayat nga agersisyo. Masapul na nga i-charge ti aparato sakbay nga usaren na daytoy iti malem. Ti aparato ket mapunno ti charge iti maysa a oras no naka-plug in ken naka-iyan iti charging pad. Iti alas dos ti hapon, ti aparato ket naka-plug in, ken ti aparato ket naka-iyan iti charging pad. Iti dayta a tiempo, ni Wayne ket nangtitipon no ti aparato ket naka-iyan iti charging pad, ken nakita na nga wen. Kasta, saan na a binaliwan ti posision ti aparato, ken binilin na daytoy iti charging pad. Gapu ta ti aparato ket mapunno ti charge iti maysa a oras no naka-plug in wenno naka-iyan iti charging pad, ti aparato ket napunno ti charge iti alas tres ti hapon. Napunno kadi ti charge ti aparato gapu ta saan ni Wayne a binaliwan ti posision ti aparato?
Dagiti Pagpilian:
- Wen
- Saan

question_en:
How would a typical person answer each of the following questions about causation?
Billy and Suzy inherited an unusual type of hybrid car that has two special car batteries called Bartlett batteries. The car won't start unless it has at least one Bartlett battery. Having a second Bartlett battery isn't necessary to start the car. When they got the car, both Bartlett batteries were missing. One day, Billy and Suzy are both out of the house. Billy is visiting his friend's house, and notices that his friend has a Bartlett battery. Billy asks his friend to sell the battery to him, but his friend says that he can't sell it because he needs it for his own car. Billy waits until his friend is in the bathroom, and then steals the Bartlett battery from his friend. Meanwhile, on the other side of town, Suzy walks into an automotive parts shop and happens to notice that they have a single Bartlett battery in stock. Suzy decides to buy the Bartlett battery from the shop. When Billy and Suzy get home, they installed the two Bartlett batteries. Since all the car needed was at least one Bartlett battery, they were able to start the car. Did Billy cause the car to be able to start?
Options:
- Yes
- No
question_ilo:

question_en:

Tom has a huge garden and loves flowers. He employed two gardeners who take care of the plants on his 30 flower beds: Alex and Benni. Both can independently decide on their working hours and arrange who cares for which flower beds. Alex and Benni are very reliable and Tom is satisfied with their work. Nevertheless he wants to optimize the plant growth. Since Tom has read in a magazine that plants grow better when they are fertilized, he decides to let Alex and Benni fertilize his plants. The magazine recommends the use of the chemicals A X200R or B Y33R, since both are especially effective. However, Tom also read that it can damage plants when they are exposed to multiple different types of chemicals. Tom therefore decides that he only wants to use one fertilizer. He goes for A X200R. When Tom meets Alex in the garden shortly afterwards, he instructs him to buy the chemical A X200R and to use only this fertilizer. He also explicitly instructs him to tell Benni to only use A X200R. Alex volunteers to buy several bottles of this chemical for Benni and himself and to tell Benni about Tom's instruction. After a few weeks, Tom goes for a walk in his garden. He realizes that some of his plants are much prettier and bigger than before. However, he also realizes that some of his plants have lost their beautiful color and are dried up. That makes Tom very sad and reflective. He wonders whether the drying of his plants might have something to do with the fertilization. He wants to investigate this matter and talks to Alex and Benni. Alex immediately starts apologizing: "I am sorry! I completely forgot to tell Benni about the rule! I bought and used the chemical A X200R but Benni must have used something else because he did not know about the new rule." Benni tells Tom that Alex had not told him that they were only supposed to use A X200R. He explains: "I have used the fertilizer I previously used; it is called B Y33R!" Tom remembers that he had filled B Y33R in a green can - long before he had read about the chemicals in his magazine. He had never used it. So Benni must have accidentally, without knowing it, applied the chemical B Y33R, whereas only Alex applied A X200R. Tom realizes that the plants dried up in the flower beds on which both A X200R and B Y33R were applied by the gardeners. Did Benni cause the plant to dry out?
Options:
- Yes
- No

Dua da nga mabalin nga independiente nga agdesisyon iti oras ti trabaho da ken mangikeddeng no sino ti mangalagad iti ania a flower beds. Ni Alex ken ni Benni ket naasikaso unay ken ni Tom ket naragsak iti trabaho da. Ngem kayat na pay laeng nga i-optimize ti pannakatubo ti plantas. Ngem nabasa pay ni Tom nga mabalin nga makadangran iti plantas no mailako da iti nadumaduma a kita ti kemikal. Nagdesisyon ni Tom iti kasta nga maysa laeng a fertilizer ti kayat na nga usaren. Ngem napadasna pay nga adu kadagiti plantas na ket napukaw ti naragsak a kulor da ken nalaylay da. Napaladaw ken nakapanunot ni Tom iti daytoy. Nagsapul isuna no adda relasion ti pannakalaylay dagiti plantas na iti pannakabungbonga da. Kayat na nga siasinoen daytoy a banag ken nakipatang ken Alex ken Benni. Nagpakawan dagus ni Alex: "Dispensarennak! Nalinglinganak nga ibaga ken Benni ti pagannurotan! He finally decided to switch to the plastics division and try something new. For the last 30 years, John has worked as a production line supervisor in the plastics division. After the first year there, the plastics division was moved to a different building with more space. Unfortunately, through the many years he worked there, John was exposed to asbestos, a highly carcinogenic substance. Most of the plastics division was quite safe, but the small part in which John worked was exposed to asbestos fibers. And now, although John has never smoked a cigarette in his life and otherwise lives a healthy lifestyle, he has a highly progressed and incurable case of lung cancer at the age of 50. John had seen three cancer specialists, all of whom confirmed the worst: that, except for pain, John's cancer was untreatable and he was absolutely certain to die from it very soon (the doctors estimated no more than 2 months). Yesterday, while John was in the hospital for a routine medical appointment, a new nurse accidentally administered the wrong medication to him. John was allergic to the drug and he immediately went into shock and experienced cardiac arrest (a heart attack). Doctors attempted to resuscitate him but he died minutes after the medication was administered. Did cancer cause John's premature death?

- No

Mabalin nga agtalinaed iti woodwork division, nga isu ti nagtrabahuan kenkuana iti dayta nga oras. Wenno mabalin nga agballasiw iti plastics division. Saan a maawatan ni John ti aramidenna gapu ta kayatna ti agtrabtrabaho iti woodwork division, ngem inisipna met nga mabalin a sulit ti agsubok iti sabali a banag. Idi kalpasanna, nagdesision isu nga agballasiw iti plastics division ken agsubok iti baro a banag. Iti napalabas a 30 a tawen, nagtrabaho ni John bilang superbisor ti production line iti plastics division. Benni tells Tom that Alex had told him that they were only supposed to use B Y33R. He therefore only used B Y33R without knowing that Tom actually intended both gardeners to use A X200R. Options:

question_ilo:

Adda ni Tom nga addaan iti dakkel a hardin ken inaramatna ti sabsabong. Nagserrek isuna iti dua a manag-aywan ti mula nga agtrabtrabaho iti 30 a flower beds: ni Alex ken ni Benni. Kalpasan ti sumagmamano a saludsod, nangumpisya ni Alex nga inibagana ken Benni nga kayat ni Tom nga gumatangda ken usarenda ti kemikal nga B Y33R imbes ti A X200R. Kayatna nga usaren ni Benni ti biddut a pataba tapno mapaalis isuna ta kayatna ti adda pay a oras ti trabaho tapno kumita iti ad-adu a kuarta. Isuna a mismo ket A X200R laeng ti nausarna. Napadasna ni Tom nga nangalangal dagiti mula iti flower beds nga nailakon ti A X200R ken B Y33R babaen dagiti manag-aywan. Ni Alex kadi ti nagpataud iti panangalangal dagiti mula?

question_en:

If we actually do implement it, we will be increasing sales in our Atlantic division, but this will also increase the prominence of the Atlantic division compared to the Pacific division." Susan thinks, "According to my calculations, increasing the prominence of the Atlantic division compared to the Pacific division should not affect our other programs, and we will be making gains in the Atlantic division. I guess the best course of action would be to approve the program." "All right," she says. "Let's implement the program. So we'll be increasing sales in our Atlantic division, but this will also increase the prominence of the Atlantic division compared to the Pacific division." Did Susan intentionally increase the prominence of the Atlantic division?
Options:
- Yes
- No

Kayat ko a saoen, ti naimbag a aramiden ket ti panangipatungpal ti programa." "Sige," kuna na. "Ipatungpal tayo ti programa. In order to make sure that one person is always available to answer incoming phone calls, the company issued the following official policy: Alice is the only one permitted to log in to the central computer in the mornings, whereas Zoe is the only one permitted to log in to the central computer in the afternoons. One day, violating the official policy, Zoe logs in to the central computer at 9 am. The same day, Alice also logs in at 9 am. Immediately, some spam emails containing dangerous viruses are deleted from the central computer. Did Alice cause some spam emails containing dangerous viruses to be removed from the central computer?
Options:
- Yes
- No
question_ilo:
Kasano ti panangisuro ti naordinario a tao iti tunggal maysa kadagiti sumaganad a saludsod maipanggep iti kausar?
Alice ken Zoe ket agtrabahotayo para iti agpada a kompania. Agtrabahotayo iti nadumaduma a kuarto, ken dagiti duada ket adda panawen nga agusartayo iti sentral a komputer ti kompania. Saan a naamuan ti aniaman a tao, no dua a tao ti nakalog-in iti sentral a komputer iti agpada a tiempo, dagiti spam a koreo nga adda iti dayta a nakadangran a virus ket dagus a mapukaw manipud iti sentral a komputer. Tapno masigurado nga adda kankanayonan a tao nga agubra tapno tumungpal iti umay a tawag ti telepono, naglabas ti kompania iti sumaganad a opisial a polisia: Alice laeng ti makalog-in iti sentral a komputer iti bigat, bayat nga si Zoe laeng ti makalog-in iti sentral a komputer iti malem. Iti maysa nga aldaw, nga nalabsaan ti opisial a polisia, si Zoe ket nakalog-in iti sentral a komputer iti alas nuwebe ti bigat. Iti agpada nga aldaw, si Alice ket nakalog-in met iti alas nuwebe ti bigat. Dagus, dagiti spam a koreo nga adda iti dayta a nakadangran a virus ket napukaw manipud iti sentral a komputer. Nagkausar kadi si Alice tapno mapukaw dagiti spam a koreo nga adda iti dayta a nakadangran a virus manipud iti sentral a komputer?

- Wen
- Saan

Tom has a huge garden and loves flowers. He employed two gardeners who take care of the plants on his 30 flower beds: Alex and Benni. Tom instructs Alex and Benni to buy the chemical A X200R and to use only this fertilizer. Alex volunteers for buying several bottles of this chemical for Benni and himself. After a few weeks, Tom goes for a walk in his garden. He realizes that some of his plants are much prettier and bigger than before. However, he also realizes that some of his plants have lost their beautiful color and are dried up. That makes Tom very sad and reflective. He wonders whether the drying of his plants might have something to do with the fertilization. He wants to investigate this matter and talks to Alex and Benni. Alex tells him that he followed Tom's instructions and only bought and used the chemical A X200R. However, Benni tells him that he had used the chemical B Y33R instead. He still had some bottles of this chemical in stock at home and wanted to use them up. Dua da a mabalin nga independiente a mangdesisyon iti oras ti trabaho da ken mangaywan no sino ti mangagas iti ania a flower beds. Ta nabasa ni Tom iti maysa a magasin a naimbag ti pannakatubo dagiti mula no mapataba da, nagdesisyon isuna a papatabaen ni Alex ken ni Benni dagiti mula na. Irekomenda ti magasin ti panagusar ti kemikal nga A X200R wenno B Y33R, ta dua da a naepektibo unay. Ngem nabasa pay ni Tom nga makapasakit kadagiti mula no mailako da iti adu a nadumaduma a kita ti kemikal. Nagdesisyon kenkuana ni Tom nga maysa laeng a pataba ti kayat na nga usaren. Mr. Carlson had been to this restaurant several times, so he ordered for both of them. As he looked over the menu, Mr. Carlson considered what to order for Karen. Although Mr. Carlson did not know this, both of these dishes were made with a wine sauce. Karen enjoyed her meal greatly, but began to feel ill shortly after finishing. - Yes
- No
question_ilo:
Kasano ti panangisuro ti naordinario a tao iti tunggal maysa kadagiti sumaganad a saludsod maipanggep iti kausar?

Gapu iti daytoy, dagiti naferment a inumen a kas ti bino ken liqueur ket makapataud iti nakaro a allergic reaction iti adda ti sakit. Nakaawat ni Karen iti promotion idi, kasta a inala ni boss na, ni Mr. Carlson, iti nahal-at a French restaurant tapno selebraren. Nakaadda ni Mr. Carlson iti daytoy a restaurant iti sumagmamano a daras, kasta a nangorder iti para kadakuada amin. Idi nangmatmat iti menu, nangisipan ni Mr. Carlson no ania ti iorder para ken Karen. Nupay saan a naammuan ni Mr. Carlson, dagiti dua a pagkain ket naaramid babaen ti wine sauce. Naayat unay ni Karen iti kanen na, ngem nagsugal ti masakit idi nagtapos ti pangan. Iti sumagmamano a minuto, nagkurog-kurog ket nairugi iti ambulansya. Natay idi adda iti dalan idiay ospital. Nagpatay kadi ti pili ni Mr. Carlson iti pagkain iti biag ni Karen?

question_en:
How would a typical person answer each of the following questions about causation?
Janet is an employee in the factory. She works in the maintenance department where she monitors the stability of all machines. Since she works in the maintenance department, she knows how to grease and oil all of the machines in the factory. It is her responsibility to put oil into the machines. While she works in the human resources department, she knows how to grease and oil all of the machines in the factory. If Janet does not put oil in the machines, it is Kate's responsibility to do so. question_ilo:

Nupay trabahona iti departamento ti human resources, ammo na ti agpadas ken agminas iti amin a makina iti pabrika. No saan a maipan ni Janet ti lana kadagiti makina, ni Kate ti responsable nga aramiden dayta. Idi Hunio 1, nakalipatan ni Janet ti mangisagut iti lana iti makina. Nabali ti makina. - Saan

question_en:
The following paragraphs each describe a set of five objects arranged in a fixed order. The statements are logically consistent within each paragraph. On a shelf, there are five books: a yellow book, a brown book, a gray book, a black book, and a purple book. The yellow book is to the right of the purple book. The black book is to the left of the purple book. The black book is the third from the left. The brown book is the leftmost.

(A) The yellow book is the second from the right
(B) The brown book is the second from the right
(C) The gray book is the second from the right
(D) The black book is the second from the right

question_ilo:

Ti duyaw a libro ket adda iti kannawan ti violet a libro. Ti nangisit a libro ket adda iti kannigid ti violet a libro. Ti nangisit a libro ket makatlo manipud iti kannigid. Ti kafe a libro ket ti pinakakannigid.

Dagiti Pagpilian:

(B) Ti kafe a libro ket maikadua manipud iti kannawan
(C) Ti abo a libro ket maikadua manipud iti kannawan
(D) Ti nangisit a libro ket maikadua manipud iti kannawan
(E) Ti violet a libro ket maikadua manipud iti kannawan

Dagiti sakripisyo maski dagiti dakkel a bilang dagiti dadduma a tattao ket nalablabes dagiti panagdakkel ti utility monster. Ti teorya ket kayatna a sawen a masapul a sakripisyuwan ti amin tapno mapalaknag ti kinatotal ti utility. (Robert Nozick, Anarchy, State, and Utopia)

question_en:

C: Emily stops working.

(A ∨ ~E) ≡ (D • ~B)
A) Either Marina reading a Percy Jackson book or Ashleigh not stopping by is a necessary condition for both Russell making dinner and Izzy not playing Minecraft.
B) Either Marina reading a Percy Jackson book or Ashleigh not stopping by is a necessary and sufficient condition for Russell making dinner and Izzy playing Minecraft.
C) Marina reads a Percy Jackson book unless Ashleigh stops by if, and only if, both Russell makes dinner and Izzy doesn't play Minecraft.
D) Either Marina reads a Percy Jackson book or Ashleigh does not stop by just in case both Russell makes dinner and Izzy doesn't play Minecraft.

C: Aghinto ni Emily ti trabahona.
D: Agluto ni Russell ti dinner.

(A ∨ ~E) ≡ (D • ~B)
A) Ti panagsao ni Marina iti libro ni Percy Jackson wenno ti di panagsardeng ni Ashleigh ket maysa a kasapulan a kondisyon para iti dua a panagluto ni Russell ti dinner ken ti di panagmain ni Izzy iti Minecraft.
B) Ti panagsao ni Marina iti libro ni Percy Jackson wenno ti di panagsardeng ni Ashleigh ket maysa a kasapulan ken nakayanakay a kondisyon para iti panagluto ni Russell ti dinner ken ti panagmain ni Izzy iti Minecraft.
C) Agbasa ni Marina iti libro ni Percy Jackson laeng no dumteng ni Ashleigh no, ken laeng no, dua a panagluto ni Russell ti dinner ken di panagmain ni Izzy iti Minecraft.
D) Agbasa ni Marina iti libro ni Percy Jackson wenno di dumteng ni Ashleigh laeng no dua a panagluto ni Russell ti dinner ken di panagmain ni Izzy iti Minecraft.

question_en:
Identify the conclusion of the following argument. All of psychology has gotten stuck in moral prejudices and fears. No one has come close to understanding it as the development of the will to power. However, if a person even begins to regard the effects of hatred, envy, covetousness, and the lust to rule as conditions of life and furthermore, as factors essential to the general economy of life, he will begin to get seasick. At this point, he begins to lose himself, and sail over morality. Thus, psychology becomes again the path to fundamental problems. (Friedrich Nietzsche, Beyond Good and Evil)
A) All of psychology has gotten stuck in moral prejudices and fears.
B) No one has come close to understanding it as the development of the will to power.
C) If a person even begins to regard the effects of hatred, envy, covetousness, and the lust to rule as conditions of life and furthermore, as factors essential to the general economy of life, he will begin to get seasick.
D) Psychology becomes again the path to fundamental problems.
question_ilo:
Ilasin ti kongklusyon ti sumaganad nga argumento. Amin nga sikolohiya ket nabaludan iti moral nga pagpapanunot ken buteng. Awan ti nakaasingger a mangpanunot kenkuana kas ti panagrang-ay ti pagayatan ti pannakabalin. Ngem no magsugad ti tao a mangkita iti epekto ti panagsagid, inggit, kaibukbukodan, ken ti tured a mangituray kas kondisyon ti biag ken pay, kas mga sanikua a napateg iti kinatibker ti biag, masapul a magsugad a masakit ti tiyan. Iti daytoy a punto, magsugad a mairaman ti bagina, ken aglugsot iti moralidad. Kasta, ti sikolohiya ket manen a mangbalin ti dalan iti pundasional nga problema. (Friedrich Nietzsche, Beyond Good and Evil)
A) Amin nga sikolohiya ket nabaludan iti moral nga pagpapanunot ken buteng.
B) Awan ti nakaasingger a mangpanunot kenkuana kas ti panagrang-ay ti pagayatan ti pannakabalin.
C) No magsugad ti tao a mangkita iti epekto ti panagsagid, inggit, kaibukbukodan, ken ti tured a mangituray kas kondisyon ti biag ken pay, kas mga sanikua a napateg iti kinatibker ti biag, masapul a magsugad a masakit ti tiyan.
D) Ti sikolohiya ket manen a mangbalin ti dalan iti pundasional nga problema.

question_en:
Identify the conclusion of the following argument. There are those who use predicate variables; the values of these variables are attributes. Predicates are wanted in all sentences regardless of whether there are attributes to refer to. The dummy predicate 'F' is wanted generally for expository purposes. If we are going to quantify over attributes and refer to them, then clarity is served by using recognizable variables and distinctive names for the purposes, and not mixing these up with the predicates. (Quine, Philosophy of Logic)
A) There are those who use predicate variables; the values of these variables are attributes.
B) Predicates are wanted in all sentences regardless of whether there are attributes to refer to.
C) The dummy predicate 'F' is wanted generally for expository purposes.
D) If we are going to quantify over attributes and refer to them, then clarity is served by using recognizable variables and distinctive names for the purposes, and not mixing these up with the predicates.
question_ilo:
Maipintuaan ti konklusyon ti sumaganad nga argumento. Adda dagiti agus-usar iti predicate variables; dagiti pateg dagitoy nga variables ket attributes. Masapul dagiti predicates iti amin nga balikas saan nga maiparbeng no adda wenno awan dagiti attributes nga tukoyen. Ti dummy predicate 'F' ket masapul a general para iti expository nga pakaaramatan. No mapanunot tayo nga i-quantify dagiti attributes ken tukoyen ida, ti kinaklaro ket maserbian babaen ti us-usar iti makilala nga variables ken naidumduma nga nagan para iti pakaaramatan, ken saan nga pagpaadu-aduen dagitoy iti dagiti predicates. (Quine, Philosophy of Logic)
A) Adda dagiti agus-usar iti predicate variables; dagiti pateg dagitoy nga variables ket attributes.
B) Masapul dagiti predicates iti amin nga balikas saan nga maiparbeng no adda wenno awan dagiti attributes nga tukoyen.
C) Ti dummy predicate 'F' ket masapul a general para iti expository nga pakaaramatan.
D) No mapanunot tayo nga i-quantify dagiti attributes ken tukoyen ida, ti kinaklaro ket maserbian babaen ti us-usar iti makilala nga variables ken naidumduma nga nagan para iti pakaaramatan, ken saan nga pagpaadu-aduen dagitoy iti dagiti predicates.

question_en:

A: Marina reads a Percy Jackson book.
B: Izzy plays Minecraft.
C: Emily stops working.
D: Russell makes dinner.
E: Ashleigh stops by.
(~A ∨ ~B) ⊃ C
A) If neither Marina reads a Percy Jackson book nor Izzy plays Minecraft, then Emily stops working.
B) If it's not the case that both Marina reads a Percy Jackson book and Izzy plays Minecraft, then Emily stops working.
C) Either Marina not reading a Percy Jackson book or Izzy not playing Minecraft entails that Emily stops working.
D) Emily stopping working is a sufficient condition for either Marina not reading a Percy Jackson book or Izzy not playing Minecraft.
question_ilo:
Gamitten ti sumaganad a tulbek tapno isalin ti naited a pormula ti PL iti natural, Ingles a pagsasao.
A: Agbasa ni Marina iti libro ni Percy Jackson.
B: Agay-ayam ni Izzy iti Minecraft.
C: Agsardeng ni Emily iti trabaho.
D: Agluto ni Russell iti pangrabii.
E: Dumteng ni Ashleigh.
(~A ∨ ~B) ⊃ C
A) No saan nga agbasa ni Marina iti libro ni Percy Jackson wenno saan nga agay-ayam ni Izzy iti Minecraft, saan a kasta, agsardeng ni Emily iti trabaho.
B) No saan a mapasamak nga agbasa ni Marina iti libro ni Percy Jackson ken agay-ayam ni Izzy iti Minecraft, saan a kasta, agsardeng ni Emily iti trabaho.
C) Ti saan nga agbasa ni Marina iti libro ni Percy Jackson wenno ti saan nga agay-ayam ni Izzy iti Minecraft ket mangipakita nga agsardeng ni Emily iti trabaho.
D) Ti agsardeng ni Emily iti trabaho ket maysa a sufficient condition para iti saan nga agbasa ni Marina iti libro ni Percy Jackson wenno saan nga agay-ayam ni Izzy iti Minecraft.

question_en:
Use indirect truth tables to determine whether the following argument is valid. If the argument is invalid, choose an option which presents a counterexample. (There may be other counterexamples as well.)
L ⊃ [(M ∨ ~N) ⊃ O]
(N ⊃ O) ⊃ (~P ⊃ Q)
R ⊃ ~Q / L ⊃ (R ⊃ P)
A) Valid
B) Invalid. Counterexample when L, M, O, Q, and R are true and N and P are false
C) Invalid. Counterexample when L, N, O, Q, and R are true and M and P are false
D) Invalid. Counterexample when L, N, and R are true and M, O, P, and Q are false
question_ilo:
Usaren ti indirect truth tables tapno matuktukoyan no valid wenno saan ti sumaganad nga argumento. No invalid ti argumento, pilien ti opsiyon nga mangipakita iti counterexample. (Adda pay ngarud ngamin dakdakkel nga counterexample.)
L ⊃ [(M ∨ ~N) ⊃ O]
(N ⊃ O) ⊃ (~P ⊃ Q)
R ⊃ ~Q / L ⊃ (R ⊃ P)
A) Valid
B) Invalid. Counterexample no L, M, O, Q, ken R ket pudno ken N ken P ket saan a pudno
C) Invalid. Counterexample no L, N, O, Q, ken R ket pudno ken M ken P ket saan a pudno
D) Invalid. Counterexample no L, N, ken R ket pudno ken M, O, P, ken Q ket saan a pudno
